items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher said, 'I just can't do it. Can you make something up for Benny?' So I was tickled to death in thinking that Fletcher asked me to write something for Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: I know he did later on, but I was --

-- later on, but he first started writing, because Benny would wake him up at ungodly hours -- four and five in the morning, you know, to write one of those things, and this is where I came in. Fletcher was so swamped, you know, and Fletcher said, "I just can't do it. Can you make something up for Benny?" So I was tickled to death in thinking that Fletcher asked me to write something for Benny Goodman. In fact, I'm thinking, "For goodness sake, that's an honor, you know. So I did do things during that era when…
Now, when you wrote -- these were written for Benny Goodman.
